name: Default
shortDescription: AI coding assistant that generates, runs and edits full-stack web apps in the browser with the LLM provider of your choice.

alerts.message: There is no built-in login: anyone who can reach the URL can use the app. Each user adds their own LLM provider API keys under Settings > Providers; keys are stored in that browser's cookies.
HTTPS is required. The in-browser WebContainer runtime needs a cross-origin isolated secure context and does not start over plain HTTP.
